csv_project_name: Design for SR-80 Southern Blvd Road Safety
csv_scope_of_work: SR-80 Southern Blvd from CR 880 to Macarthur Diary Road. Safety Project. The safety project focuses on addressing lane-departure crashes by installing additional lighting and adding flashers to the curve warning signs in both eastbound and westbound directions. The improvements also include extending the existing guardrail on the south side of SR 80 east of CR 880 and installing a new guardrail on the north side of SR 80 west of 210th Trail. Additional work involves correcting cross slopes, milling and resurfacing within the study limits, improving superelevation in the curve area, and widening both the inside and outside paved shoulders in both directions. The project also calls for installing left and right edge-line rumble striping throughout the study area and adding flexible backplates at the SR 80/CR 880 intersection for the eastbound and westbound approaches.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Electrical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Utility Engineering, Hydrology/Hydraulics, Stormwater, Traffic Design Engineering
